summary: San Francisco Bay Area resident, software engineer with 15+ years of experience, specializes in machine learning and data science, strong opinions on tech industry practices and corporate ethics, critical of hiring practices and employee treatment in tech, advocates for better work-life balance and employee rights, has a history of job switching for better compensation, engaged in discussions about privacy and data security, expresses frustration with public transportation and housing issues in the Bay Area, has a strong interest in programming languages and software development practices, critical of corporate monopolies and their impact on innovation and employee welfare.
